scene: Through the telescope, the catwalk opens onto a breezy rooftop transit terrace.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a tiled open-air terrace atop the library. On the left, a striped ferris wheel gondola hangs docked at an iron gate. Left of centre stands the tall Latino player with his messenger bag. In the centre, an indigo night bus idle beside a stop. On the right, a yellow bicycle rickshaw waits.
